question.en: The product of two consecutive natural numbers is 110. The greater of the two numbers is:
question.hi: दो क्रमागत प्राकृ त संख्याओं का गुणनफल 110 है। दोनों संख्याओं में से बड़ी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।

solution.approach: Verified Answer: **11** ($10 \times 11 = 110$).
solution.keyConcept: Product of Consecutive n(n+1) = P ⇒ Split Around √P

steps.en: Since $10^2 = 100 < 110 < 11^2 = 121$, the consecutive numbers MUST be **10 & 11**!

solution.en:
Method 1: Quadratic Equation $x(x+1) = 110$: $x(x+1) = 110 \Rightarrow x^2 + x - 110 = 0 \Rightarrow (x + 11)(x - 10) = 0 \Rightarrow x = 10, x+1 = 11$. Answer: **11**.

Method 2: Square Sandwich $10^2 < 110 < 11^2$ (`3 sec`): Since $10^2 = 100 < 110 < 11^2 = 121$, the consecutive numbers MUST be **10 & 11**!
